description: This file defines a Polymer behavior for multi-selectable elements, specifically implementing the IronMultiSelectableBehavior which allows multiple selection toggling and management of selected items or values in a Polymer component.

classes.name: Polymer.IronMultiSelectableBehaviorImpl
classes.description: Behavior object implementing multi-selection logic, toggling selection states, and managing selected items/values.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects the given value; toggles if multi-selection is enabled.

methods.name: multiChanged
methods.description: Observer method called when the 'multi' property changes; updates internal selection mode.

methods.name: _updateSelected
methods.description: Updates the current selection state based on 'selected' or 'selectedValues'.

methods.name: _selectMulti
methods.description: Sets multiple items as selected based on provided values.

methods.name: _selectionChange
methods.description: Handles change in selection, updating 'selectedItems' and 'selectedItem'.

methods.name: _toggleSelected
methods.description: Toggles the selection status of a value.
